players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: The Eagles ruled Hurts out for Week 6 vs. CAR on Oct 15 after a follow-up ultrasound showed his calf blood clot had moved; Rapoport called him 'out indefinitely' and said blood thinners are possible, which would keep him off the field. Tanner McKee starts.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: Jackson (ankle) missed practice again Thursday, Oct 15, his second straight DNP, though Schefter still reports a 'realistic chance' he plays at CLE. Tyler Huntley would start again if he can't go.

players.name: Caleb Williams
players.note: Williams (hamstring) was a full participant again Thursday, Oct 15, and is on track to return in Week 6 at ATL, though Ben Johnson has not officially named him the starter.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: Mayfield (dislocated right thumb) sat out practice again Thursday, Oct 15, and Jalon Daniels is set to make a third straight start vs. PIT. Garafolo says Mayfield is 'working his way back but not there yet.'

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Barkley (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday (Oct 14-15) and is tracking to miss a second straight game, Week 6 vs. Carolina.

players.name: Dameon Pierce
players.note: With Barkley (hamstring) and Will Shipley (foot) both out of practice Wed-Thu (Oct 14-15) and Tank Bigsby on IR, Pierce is in line to lead Philadelphia's backfield vs. Carolina. He finished Week 5 as the last healthy back, with 11 carries for 14 yards.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.note: Judkins (ankle) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday (Oct 14-15). He was out of the walking boot but sat out stretching and individual drills, so his Week 6 status vs. Baltimore looks shaky.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: The Browns opened Sampson's 21-day IR return window on Oct 14, and he was limited at practice Thursday (Oct 15). Monken said he likely needs a full practice to be activated for Week 6 vs. Baltimore, where Judkins is ailing.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.note: Hall (quad) again did not practice Thursday (Oct 15). Coach Aaron Glenn calls him week-to-week, and he is unlikely to play Week 6 vs. New England.

players.name: Braelon Allen
players.note: With Hall (quad) still not practicing as of Oct 15, Allen should lead the Jets backfield again vs. New England. He played 32 of 34 offensive snaps in Week 5.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Kamara (back) was limited again Thursday (Oct 15) but is not viewed as in real danger of missing Week 6 at the Giants. Lingering concern after his season-low 12 snaps in Week 5.

players.name: Kendre Miller
players.note: Kamara (back) was still limited at practice Thursday (Oct 15), so Miller should keep a bigger share after scoring New Orleans' only offensive TD in Week 5.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (ankle) missed practice Wednesday and Thursday (Oct 14-15) and sounds run-down. A report says Arizona may give him the week to heal before Week 6 at the Rams.

players.name: Tyler Allgeier
players.note: Love (ankle) missed practice Wed-Thu (Oct 14-15) and may sit Week 6 at the Rams. Trey Benson is on IR, so Allgeier would be Arizona's lead back.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Spears (knee) was downgraded from limited Wednesday to a non-participant Thursday (Oct 15), putting Week 6 at Indianapolis in doubt.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.note: Spears (knee) did not practice Thursday (Oct 15), so Pollard could see a bigger share of Tennessee's backfield at Indianapolis in Week 6.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Monangai (toe/thumb) missed practice again Thursday (Oct 15), his second straight DNP, and looks likely to be unavailable for Week 6 vs. Atlanta.

players.name: D'Andre Swift
players.note: With Monangai missing practice Wed-Thu (Oct 14-15) and likely out for Week 6 vs. Atlanta, Swift should handle a larger share of Chicago's backfield.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.note: Croskey-Merritt (groin) was absent from practice Thursday (Oct 15). One report called it maintenance, and Washington doesn't play until Monday at San Francisco, so he has extra time.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.note: Croskey-Merritt (groin) missed practice Thursday (Oct 15). If he can't play Monday at San Francisco, White would get a bigger role.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) did not practice Wednesday (Oct 14). He is week-to-week, is listed out for Week 6 vs. Jacksonville in London, and could also miss Week 7 ahead of the Week 8 bye.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: With Montgomery (groin) out, Marks is set to lead Houston's backfield vs. Jacksonville in Week 6. The matchup is tough, but the volume makes him an RB2/3. Jawhar Jordan may be elevated as depth.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: Henderson (right high-ankle sprain, Week 5) is expected to miss multiple weeks without surgery, per Schefter (Oct 13-14), likely including the Jets and Bears games.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: With Henderson out multiple weeks (high-ankle sprain, Oct 13-14), Stevenson should take a heavier load starting Week 6 vs. the Jets, with Corey Kiner in a change-of-pace role.

players.name: Jaylen Warren
players.note: McCarthy has named Warren the featured back after his 188-scrimmage-yard, 2-TD Week 5. Dowdle practiced fully Thursday (Oct 15) for the first time since Week 2 but projects as the backup vs. Tampa Bay.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Limited again Thursday (Oct 15) in his second practice since being designated to return from IR (ankle). Brown called his status for Sunday vs. the Jets 'still up in the air', and Vrabel says there is no guarantee he plays.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: Practiced fully again Thursday (Oct 15) after returning from wrist surgery, and reports list him with no game designation for Sunday at Cleveland. He looks on track to play.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Upgraded to limited Thursday (Oct 15), his first practice after missing two games (hamstring/toe). Mike Garafolo reports optimism he plays Sunday vs. Carolina, but Jalen Hurts (calf) is out and Tanner McKee will start.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.note: Downgraded from limited to did not practice Thursday (Oct 15) with a hamstring injury, and he may miss Sunday vs. Carolina. Tanner McKee starts at QB with Hurts out.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Did not practice Thursday (Oct 15) with the shoulder (AC joint) injury and has not practiced at all this week. He is trending toward missing Sunday at Las Vegas, and Buffalo has a bye in Week 7.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Did not practice Wednesday or Thursday (Oct 14-15) after a procedure on his injured finger. He is week-to-week and expected to miss a fourth straight game Sunday vs. New England.

players.name: Chris Olave
players.note: Did not practice Wednesday or Thursday (Oct 14-15) because of an illness. An illness is usually short-term, but watch Friday's report before Sunday vs. the Giants.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Limited Wednesday and Thursday (Oct 14-15) with the foot injury from Week 4, and he seems on track to play Sunday vs. Baltimore. KC Concepcion's concussion could mean more targets for him.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Was evaluated for a shoulder injury in the third quarter of Thursday's (Oct 15) 17-14 overtime win over Seattle but returned to the game. Denver gained only 168 yards of offense, so watch his health next week.

players.name: Deebo Samuel
players.note: Still out with the hamstring strain from Oct 11. Shanahan said on Oct 12 he will miss at least a couple of weeks.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Minnesota is on its bye in Week 6, and reports from Oct 12-14 say Addison (hamstring) is expected back for Week 7.

players.name: Marvin Harrison
players.note: Harrison passed his physical and practiced with Houston on Wednesday, Oct 14. DeMeco Ryans confirmed he will play vs. Jacksonville in London in Week 6, but warned not to expect a full 60-snap workload.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: With Harrison traded to Houston (official Oct 12), Wilson is clearly Arizona's top WR. He leads the team with 258 receiving yards.

players.name: Nico Collins
players.note: Marvin Harrison Jr. is set to debut for Houston in Week 6 in London (Ryans, Oct 14), so there is more competition for targets. Collins stays the WR1, with a slightly lower target-share ceiling.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.note: Dell is still on IR, with his practice window open since Oct 7. Houston's trade for Marvin Harrison Jr. (Oct 12) pushes him further down the pecking order once he is activated.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.note: Rice (hamstring/knee) did not practice Wednesday, Oct 14, even after the bye, and Andy Reid was noncommittal about his return. His Week 6 game vs. the Chargers is in doubt.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.note: Tyquan Thornton is on IR (Oct 12) and Rashee Rice did not practice Wednesday, Oct 14. That leaves Worthy as KC's clear top WR for Week 6 vs. the Chargers.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: Harris (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday, Oct 14, after Harbaugh called him 'week to week' on Oct 13. With the Week 7 bye, his realistic return is Week 8.

players.name: Quentin Johnston
players.note: Johnston (chest) was limited in practice Wednesday, Oct 14, after missing Week 5. He could return in Week 6 at Kansas City.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey (foot) was limited Wednesday, Oct 14, after playing zero offensive snaps while active in Week 5. His Week 6 role at KC is uncertain.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Mike McCarthy ruled Wilson (finger) out for Week 6 at Tampa Bay on Oct 13. Reports say he will miss multiple weeks.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans was listed questionable (ribs) on Oct 15. With Deebo Samuel (hamstring) expected to miss time through the Week 8 bye, Evans is SF's clear top WR when healthy.

players.name: KC Concepcion
players.note: The rookie has been in the concussion protocol since a helmet-to-helmet hit vs. the Jets on Oct 11. His Week 6 availability is doubtful.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: New England opened A.J. Brown's IR practice window on Oct 14, and Brown was limited. His return would cut into Doubs' targets soon.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.note: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) was not seen at practice Wednesday, Oct 14, after missing two straight games. If Smith sits again in Week 6 vs. Carolina, Lemon keeps an elevated target share.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: On Oct 14 agent Drew Rosenhaus said Hill is 'close' to 100% from his knee injury and is being shopped to contenders. He also remains under an NFL personal conduct review.

players.name: Pat Bryant
players.note: Bryant was placed on injured reserve with an ankle injury (Sleeper, Oct 13), so he is out at least through Week 9.

players.name: Michael Pittman
players.note: Pittman was placed on injured reserve with a foot injury (Sleeper, Oct 13), so he will miss at least four games.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.note: Diggs is listed questionable (hamstring) as of Oct 14 after the hamstring issue cost him practice time before Week 5. His Week 6 status is uncertain.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin is listed questionable (hamstring) as of Oct 15. The hamstring has bothered him since before Week 4.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Flowers is listed questionable (toe) as of Oct 15. Earlier this month he was limited in practice with a foot injury.

players.name: Kenyon Sadiq
players.note: Sadiq (concussion, suffered in Week 5 vs. CLE) remained in the protocol and did not practice Wednesday, Oct 14, per The Athletic. He needs to practice Thursday/Friday and get independent neurologist clearance to play at New England, and Mason Taylor would lead the Jets' TE room if he sits.

players.name: Darren Waller
players.note: Waller (toe) was limited on Wednesday's Oct 14 practice estimate coming out of Carolina's bye, and TE Tommy Tremble (ribs) was also limited. Thursday/Friday practices will decide whether he carries a designation into Sunday at Philadelphia.

players.name: Eli Stowers
players.note: The Eagles opened Stowers' 21-day IR practice window on Oct 14 (quad/hamstring, out since Week 1). He isn't guaranteed to be activated for Week 6 vs. Carolina and would back up Dallas Goedert when he returns.

players.name: Matt Hibner
players.note: Sleeper lists the Ravens rookie as questionable with a hand injury (since Oct 14), and no Week 6 practice update has turned up. He's a low-volume backup with no change to his role.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.note: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith both missed practice again Wednesday, Oct 14, so Goedert (6-9-38 in his Week 5 return) looks set to stay Jalen Hurts' top short-area target vs. Carolina. Rookie Eli Stowers' IR practice window opened the same day, but he would be a backup.
